purpose: Hacer que los frentes visuales sobrevivan al chat mediante handoffs y prompts reencarnables.
important_ideas: One prompt should recover feedback/history/versions and prepare a disposable chat to continue work.
Visual state must outlive any one conversation.
decisions: A future chat must know it will be abandoned and publish enough continuity for the next incarnation.
